title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier W/ Towel Bar | Solid Brass | Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier With Towel Bar
description:
Clear counter clutter and keep towels within reach with a wall-mounted glass shelf designed for everyday bathroom organization. This traditional bathroom hardware piece combines three tiers of tempered, beveled-edged glass with solid brass hardware and an integrated towel bar for a clean, coordinated look.

Highlights:
• Gain vertical storage for daily essentials with a triple-tier design
• Store with confidence using 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with beveled edges
• Keep hand towels or decorative towels ready on the integrated towel bar
• Maintain a streamlined look with concealed screw mounting hardware
• Coordinate with classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures across your space

Specs & Installation:
• Glass size: 16 x 5 inches
• Overall size: 16 in L x 18 in H x 5 in W
• Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8 in)
• Weight capacity: 6 lb
• Mounting: wall mount
• Assembly: no assembly required
• Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screws: #8 x 1 1/4)
• Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Featuring tempered, beveled-edged glass and solid brass hardware this shelf is crafted for durability, strength and style. One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass Collection of products, this subtle glass shelf is the perfect complement to your bathroom decor.
